title: Record reproducible release inputs
scope: Capture source/toolchain/dependency versions, build options, generated artifacts and artifact checksums.
acceptance: Two clean builds compare manifests and classify nondeterministic binary differences.
No claim of bit-identical output without evidence; no workstation paths required at runtime.
evidence: PASS: clean source 6f821a55e92bc4d0fe0e3c26aa55fb14470539d0 produced matching sets of 164 installed and 20 generated artifacts; inputs matched and docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-04-release-reproducibility.json records checksums and classifications.
PASS: installed runtime metadata had zero required workstation-path hits and 39/39 SDK tests passed; bit-identical output is explicitly not established because five installed artifacts differed.
